out_root: <folder where each tag's plates, checks and row.txt are made>

masters.andromeda: <path to the owner's M31 RGB master, FITS, 3 planes>
masters.tarantula: <path to the held-out Tarantula master of 2026-10-17, FITS, 3 planes, PIXORIG = 1>
masters.sag: <path to the Sagittarius Triplet master, mono or RGB>

arm.run: <frozen copy of training/denoise at the arm's commit (r2_infer.py, n2n_export.py)>
arm.remove_cli: <tianwen executable that runs image remove-stars over M31>
arm.reports: <folder real-star-read-<name>.txt, ring-<name>.txt and m31-nucleus-<name>.txt are written to>
arm.logs_root: <folder score-<name>/ (logs, the ONNX) is made under>
arm.twins_root: <folder holding the plain and lobed twin exports>
arm.val_list: <the validation sessions list, relative to run: arms/r2-val.txt>
arm.m31_master: <the owner's M31 RGB master (the same file as masters.andromeda)>
arm.m31_out: <folder M31's 8-view starless plates are written to>
real_star_baselines: <an output folder name under eval_root the real-star check lists beside the arm>
ring_baselines: <an output folder name the ring check lists beside the arm>
arm.nucleus_reference: <an earlier arm's M31 plate the nucleus read is printed beside>
